milestones.title: Milestone 1: Wood Age (Logs / Planks / Crafting Table / Wooden Pickaxe)
milestones.details: Harvest wood logs and assemble basic wooden tools.

milestones.title: Milestone 2: Stone Age (Cobblestone / Stone Pickaxe / Stone Sword)
milestones.details: Mine cobblestone and upgrade to stone tools & weapons.

milestones.title: Milestone 3: Iron Age (Smelting / Iron Ingot / Iron Pickaxe / Shield)
milestones.details: Smelt iron ore into ingots and craft an iron pickaxe and shield.

milestones.title: Milestone 4: Diamond & Obsidian Age (Diamond Pickaxe / Obsidian)
milestones.details: Mine diamonds and harvest obsidian blocks for the Nether portal.

milestones.title: Milestone 5: Nether Expedition (Blaze Rods & Ender Pearls)
milestones.details: Enter the Nether, harvest blaze rods, and craft Eyes of Ender.

milestones.title: Milestone 6: Mathematical Stronghold Triangulation
milestones.details: Execute DeepMind 2-ray vector triangulation to locate the Stronghold.

milestones.title: Milestone 7: End Dimension & Crystal Sniping
milestones.details: Activate End portal and destroy protective End Crystals with bow.

milestones.title: Milestone 8: Ender Dragon Slain ("Free the End")
milestones.details: Slay the Ender Dragon to achieve complete Minecraft survival victory.
